transport.format: UTF-8 NDJSON objects, one LF-terminated object per message
transport.token: 64 hexadecimal characters generated for this host process; launch arguments only; never committed or logged

identity_and_order.session_id: UUID stable for the Qt host process lifetime
identity_and_order.connection_id: new UUID for every accepted renderer connection
identity_and_order.seq: independent positive increasing JSON integers in each direction; exact integer range 1..9007199254740991
identity_and_order.stale_session_connection_or_seq: ignore without changing current action or consuming incoming sequence
identity_and_order.request_id: connection UUID plus a monotonically increasing host request counter
identity_and_order.old_request_ack: ignore, trace stale_ack_rejected, preserve the current foreground request

handshake.note: Unauthenticated message has no session/connection/seq fields.

required.capabilities: array of strings, <=64 entries and <=64 characters each

handshake.note: Send only after model, rig and scene can receive semantic requests.

post_handshake_envelope.seq: strictly newer than the previously accepted incoming message

fields.revision: host activity revision, increasing; gaps permitted
fields.foreground_request_id: current request ID string or empty string

activity.snapshot.semantics: Replace activity truth. Busy is independent of foreground animations and is never inferred from how the character looks.

fields.name: one of delete.react/work.finished/wave
fields.ttl_ms: 12000 from current Qt host; relative duration, never absolute clock time

icon_position.coordinate_space: Qt logical global screen coordinates; current Godot overlay does not consume this hint

action.request.ttl: Qt timeout starts when sent; renderer timeout starts when received. Process-relative monotonic clocks are not compared. Current renderer clamps incoming TTL to 50..12000ms.

action.cancel.semantics: Only cancel when the ID is the current foreground action.

action.ack.semantics: started preserves the current foreground. Terminal statuses clear only the matching current ID and restore the latest activity. Duplicate or old acknowledgements cannot finish a newer action.

host.shutdown.semantics: Atomically hide all scene visuals, present a transparent GPU frame, save review results when enabled, then exit.

client.quit.semantics: Request the Qt host and its child renderer to exit, e.g. right-click close.

sources: DesktopDeleteSource Shell notifications on a hidden native Qt HWND
activity_truth.active_turn_count: All tracked sessions and turns, including concurrent busy-to-busy events. Duplicate start IDs remain one active turn. A stop without turn_id ends the latest tracked turn in that session. Session end clears that session without a work-finished celebration. Existing 12-hour expiry and reset behavior are preserved.
activity_truth.same_state_updates: Qt publishes snapshots for source calls even when its visible Busy state is unchanged. A one-second poll also notices expiry count changes.
activity_truth.private_data: File paths, file contents, hook session IDs and Cubism parameters are not sent to the renderer.

foreground_arbitration.delete_behavior: Accepted delete reaction replaces any current foreground request, including an earlier delete. It does not perform a file operation.
foreground_arbitration.work_finished_behavior: Only the real last turn stop nominates this action. It is dropped when a foreground request already exists. A new active turn cancels a running work.finished with activity_changed.
foreground_arbitration.wave_behavior: Qt nominates only if the foreground is free; Godot accepts only with an idle standing wave rig.
foreground_arbitration.foreground_and_busy: Deletion can run while activity remains busy. Completion falls back to the latest busy count, not the snapshot captured when the action started.
foreground_arbitration.unsupported_action: Drop without forcing the unsupported animation; return Qt deletion state to the latest background activity.

disconnect_and_reconnect.host: Clear foreground action and restore current activity immediately. Retain real tracked agent turns. Drop events while no renderer is ready. Never queue or replay historical deletions/celebrations.
disconnect_and_reconnect.renderer: Clear transient actions and seen request IDs, reset revision, smoothly return to idle and attempt reconnect every 1 second.
disconnect_and_reconnect.reconnect: New connection_id handshake, then current activity snapshot only. An old connection ACK never affects the new connection.

activity.idle.representation: Current GLB idle clip and runtime blink/expression; proxy/candidate, not approved Whale Girl.

activity.busy.representation_with_sit_clip: Bidirectional seek of the imported sit clip; fully seated static workstation only at sit_progress>=0.999.
activity.busy.representation_without_sit_clip: Standing expression placeholder, no invented seated anatomy.

delete.react.representation: Small head nod, blink and smile overlay, 1.2-second nominal action. No object retrieval/eating animation or file operation.

work.finished.representation: Short return gaze/expression then sit-to-idle recovery, 1-second nominal overlay.

wave.available: Only advertised when a wave clip exists; accepted only idle and standing.

current_renderer_capabilities.source_of_truth: ready.capability_details records actual model_sha256, blend shapes, head bone and busy_style. A semantic capability is not proof of complete art or anatomy.

optional.--toon-replay <json>: Isolate sources: no real Codex QLocalServer or Shell desktop listener. Start replay once the renderer is ready.
optional.--toon-review-profile <json>: Require existing file, forward absolute Godot --review-profile; profile content validation belongs to the review runner/renderer.

qt_launch.real_endpoint_collision: Fail visibly/report exit 2 before launching the renderer if the existing Codex endpoint is in use. Do not remove server, kill another pet or change user hooks.
qt_launch.old_backend_coexistence: Branch before constructing PetWindow; no second Qt pet in this mode. Launching without --toon-host retains the old backend.
qt_launch.window_startup: Godot child uses STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW/SW_HIDE and CREATE_NO_WINDOW; FocusGuard remains required in the staged project. Qt only creates a hidden notification HWND.
qt_launch.shutdown: Send semantic shutdown first. Wait at most 2 seconds, then terminate only this host child, then kill after another 1 second if necessary. No existing Godot process is controlled.

development_runtime_metadata.observed_issue: Historical workspace Low Mandatory Label on compiled executables propagates a Low child token, denying Godot user:// logs and the root certificate store.
development_runtime_metadata.test_runner_solution: Normal byte-identical packaging of only this run's exe/DLLs into a fresh unique TEMP runtime; source/system ACLs and tokens are not modified.
development_runtime_metadata.helper_launcher_modes: tools/review_toon_host.py normally packages both isolated replay and explicit --live into fresh unique TEMP runtimes. Source/system ACLs are unchanged.
development_runtime_metadata.direct_raw_cli: Direct build/DesktopCompanion.exe --toon-host keeps the historical Low label and can still hit the log/certificate errors.
development_runtime_metadata.hook_helper_compatibility: Raw build/DesktopCompanionHook.exe also has a Low label and cannot connect to a normal packaged host named pipe. A normally deployed same-package helper can connect. Include the helper in the package, but do not automatically change the user hook config in this run.
development_runtime_metadata.production_source_verification: The unique endpoint probe proves IPC integrity compatibility only. It does not establish real Codex hooks or Shell deletion delivery. Current GPU replay has real_sources_enabled:false.

replay_schema.agent_fields: start needs nonempty session_id and turn_id; stop/session_end need session_id; stop turn_id may be empty

verification.gpu_gate: Separate root review directory and check_toon_host_review.py; no approval implied by Qt unit tests.
